data.exact_reserve_text: For the year ended 31 December 2016 the Syndicate recorded a profit of $12.4 (2015 loss of $33.0) of which $17.1 was attributable to movement in prior years.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 780 experienced material adverse prior-year reserve development in 2016. Analysis of the gross claims development table shows a net strengthening (increase) in gross outstanding claims of approximately 117.1 (USD millions) driven by adverse development in older underwriting years (notably 2014 and 2013) consistent with large-loss and adverse claims development. No single quantified gross movement in a narrative movement note was found; the figure above is calculated from the gross claims development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: of which $17.1 was attributable to movement in prior years
movement in the Syndicate's claims reserves
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2016 (balance-sheet prior-year comparative) could not be unambiguously read from the provided images, so opening_reserves is left null. Prior year development (117.1) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 29) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years up to 2014. The exact gross movement narrative/gross movement note was not clearly present; a sentence referring to '$17.1 attributable to movement in prior years' appears in the report but is likely a net (after reinsurance) figure. Premium mix was not clearly given in a consolidated divisional summary so a single 'Reinsurance' line was used to match total gross premium; this may not reflect the full segmentation in the statutory note. All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD millions).
